auth.namePlaceholder: For example, Anna or Anna Karimova
auth.passwordHint: At least {min} characters. You can paste a password from a password manager.
auth.providersUnavailable: Signing in with Apple and Google comes once the providers are connected.

error.nameRequired: Tell us how to address you
error.termsRequired: You need to accept the terms of use
error.signupFailed: Could not create an account with this email. If you already have an account, sign in or recover the password.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.body: We sent an email to {email}. Follow the link in it.
verify.step1: Open the email and follow the link.
verify.step2: Sign in with this email and password.
verify.step3: Tell us about yourself in a couple of minutes, or skip it.
verify.demoOnboarding: See the profile set-up in the demo

visual.signupSub: Meet people and companies, share knowledge and build projects.
visual.recoverHeadline: We restore access without needless questions.
visual.recoverSub: The link arrives by email; the account stays yours.

recover.title: Password recovery
recover.body: Enter the email you sign in with. We will send a link to change the password.
recover.sent: If this email is registered, we sent a message. Check the spam folder.
recover.noMailboxBody: Changing the sign-in email without access to the old mailbox goes through a separate check. Contact support after the service launches.
recover.sentAgain: If this email is registered, we sent the link again.

reset.title: New password
reset.tokenExpired: The link has expired. Request a new one.
reset.tokenUsed: This link has already been used.
reset.body: Choose a new password. The old one stops working as soon as you save.

points.companies: Verified companies and people of the industry
points.projects: Projects, requests and quotes in one place
points.magazine: The weekly magazine, courses and certificates
points.trust: Honest statuses: no ratings and no gaming
points.recoverSafe: The recovery link is valid for a limited time

strength.label: Password strength
strength.tipMix: Mix letters, digits and symbols, or use a phrase of several words.

next.title: What is next
next.step1: Confirm your email through the link in the message.
next.step2: Tell us who you are in the industry and what interests you; this is optional.
next.step3: Open the workspace: the magazine, courses, people, companies and projects.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Press the button to confirm this address. You will be signed in right away.
verifyEmail.invalidBody: It has expired or was already used. Sign in, or sign up again to get a new link.

logout.title: Sign out
logout.body: {name}, end the session on this device?

secondFactor.title: Two-step verification
secondFactor.body: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
secondFactor.recoveryBody: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
secondFactor.recoveryHint: For example abcd-efgh-ijkm-npqr. Case and hyphens do not matter.
secondFactor.codeFormat: Enter the six digits shown in the app
secondFactor.recoveryFormat: A recovery code has 16 letters and digits
secondFactor.invalidCode: The code is not correct or was already used. Wait for the next code and try again.
secondFactor.expired: The sign-in took too long or was already completed. Sign in again.

invitation.title: Company invitation
invitation.oneEmployer: Accepting makes this company your employer here. You work for one company at a time and can leave it later in the company settings.
invitation.invalidBody: It has expired, was already used or was sent to another account. Sign in with the address the invitation was sent to, or ask the company for a new invitation.
invitation.signInBody: Sign in with the account the invitation was sent to. You will come back here to see the company and accept.
invitation.noAccount: Invitations go only to existing accounts. If you use another address here, ask the company to invite that address.
invitation.demo: This is a demo: no invitation is checked or accepted.

auth.termsDraft: The terms of use and the privacy notice of this hub are drafts and not in force yet; the linked pages say so.
